goal: Die bestehende HTTP-Antwort, unveränderte eingebettete HTML/CSS/JavaScript-Grenzen, Syntax und Nur-Lesen-Sicherheit vor der geplanten Modulaufteilung nachweisbar absichern.

guide_delta.summary: Das Programm selbst bleibt unverändert. Vor einer späteren Aufteilung wird automatisch geprüft, dass Browsercode, HTML-Antwort und reine Lesezugriffe erhalten bleiben.

direct_dependencies: I176 test-first baseline for optional future extraction of inline JS and CSS
tests_required: run I176 asset-boundary, Node syntax and HTTP response invariants
tests_explicitly_not_run: actual headless Chromium visual acceptance: no UI or runtime logic changed
schema, domain and storage deep gates: frozen and untouched
full repository test suite: separate release validation
risks: the 2415-line browser shell remains monolithic until a separately authorized extraction
Node must be available on the Linux CI runner for syntax verification
an external JS or CSS URL would change the current GET-only server contract; extraction should initially preserve inline output
later extraction must prove byte-for-byte generated HTML and complete existing tests
non_changes: no change to browser_shell.py or the returned HTML
no HTTP asset routes, no new dependencies, no database writes
no CP-03 or CP-06 reopening, no README or TODO progress changes
no declaration of visual or release acceptance
expected_side_effects: I176 test becomes a repeatable baseline before any future code extraction
the existing editor response is compared to its WSGI body byte-for-byte
Node parses the embedded JavaScript without execution
